summary: Russian forces launched a massive drone and missile barrage across western and central Ukraine, striking the Burshtyn thermal power plant and Kyiv residential districts with Geran-5/Shahed UAVs, causing casualties. Ukrainian Neptune missiles damaged the Kerch Bridge railway section, halting train traffic critical for Russian southern logistics. Russia's 2027 budget allocates 35% of expenditures to defense, a 32% increase, signaling long-term war commitment.
key_points: Russian Geran-5 and Shahed drones attacked Lviv, Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Ivano-Frankivsk, and Chernihiv regions, hitting the Burshtyn TPP and Kyiv infrastructure with at least 4 injured in Kyiv and 1 killed in Bucha district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78540, @mon1tor_ua/78573, @UkraineNow/85406, @UkraineNow/85398).
Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck the Kerch Bridge railway arch and tracks, stopping train movement and disrupting Russian ammunition supply lines to the southern front (Source: @UkraineNow/85396).

Russia's 2027 federal budget designates 17.1 trillion rubles for national defense, a 32% increase, comprising 35% of total expenditures, while cutting health and social spending (Source: @DeepStateUA/24016).
The UK and Norway pledged over £100 million to build two strike boats for the Ukrainian Navy to strengthen Black Sea coastal defense and protect grain corridors (Source: @DeepStateUA/24014).

Trump, Xi Jinping, and Putin held a trilateral meeting in China, adopting a declaration on nuclear risk reduction, ICC reform, immunities for officials, increased oil production, and UN reform (Source: @UkraineNow/85397).
Zelensky insisted any territorial negotiations must involve him directly, stating Ukrainians demonstrated readiness to defend their homeland in 2022 (Source: @UkraineNow/85413).
Ukraine's DOT-Chain Defence procurement system delivered 1.5 million drones to the military with a 9-day average delivery time, attracting NATO study (Source: @UkraineNow/85395).
A ballistic missile struck near the Paton/Pivdennyi bridges in Kyiv according to monitoring channels (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78538).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a large-scale drone and missile attack across western and central Ukraine, employing Geran-5 and Shahed UAVs that hit the Burshtyn thermal power plant and multiple Kyiv districts, resulting in casualties. Ukrainian forces countered with a precision Neptune missile strike on the Kerch Bridge railway section, disrupting a key Russian logistics artery for the southern front. Meanwhile, Russia's 2027 budget reveals a 32% increase in defense spending to 17.1 trillion rubles, confirming a long-term militarization trajectory.

points: Ukrainian Neptune anti-ship missiles successfully struck the railway portion of the Kerch Bridge, hitting the arch and tracks, which halted all train traffic; this bridge serves as a primary supply conduit for Russian forces in the south, transporting fuel and ammunition via rail (Source: @UkraineNow/85396).

The DOT-Chain Defence procurement platform has delivered 1.5 million drones to Ukrainian forces, including FPV fiber-optic, bomber, interceptor, and EW systems, from 300 manufacturers across 1,200 catalog positions, with an average 9-day delivery cycle; NATO countries are studying this model (Source: @UkraineNow/85395).

President Zelensky declared that if Putin wishes to discuss territories, he must speak directly with him, emphasizing that Ukrainians proved their resolve to defend their homeland in 2022 and will not cede land (Source: @UkraineNow/85413).

Kyiv's air defenses recorded at least four confirmed interceptions of Shahed drones over the capital, with debris damaging residential buildings, an office, a medical facility, and nine vehicles in Holosiivskyi, Desnianskyi, and Podilskyi districts; one person was killed and another injured in Bucha district (Source: @UkraineNow/85406, @UkraineNow/85398, @mon1tor_ua/78557).

Head of Defence Intelligence Kyrylo Budanov met with business leaders to address obstacles for defense industry production, discussing war risk insurance, shelter requirements, credit access, specialist booking quotas, logistics, and export of defense products (Source: @UkraineNow/85408).

The United Kingdom and Norway committed over £100 million to construct two strike boats for the Ukrainian Navy, to be built in the UK with European equipment, funded equally via the Maritime Coalition; this aims to enhance Black Sea coastal defense and secure grain export corridors that have moved 200 million tons of cargo (Source: @DeepStateUA/24014).

Monitoring channels reported a ballistic missile impact near the Paton and Pivdennyi bridges in Kyiv, indicating continued Russian use of high-value munitions against critical infrastructure (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78538).

Russian forces launched waves of Geran-5 (Shahed-136) one-way attack drones and reactive UAVs across at least 10 Ukrainian regions, including Lviv, Ivano-Frankivsk, Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Chernihiv, Rivne, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, and Mykolaiv, with multiple groups tracked by radar networks (Source: @eRadarrua/132052, @eRadarrua/132062, @eRadarrua/132064, @eRadarrua/132108, @eRadarrua/132115, @eRadarrua/132123, @eRadarrua/132126, @mon1tor_ua/78562, @mon1tor_ua/78570, @mon1tor_ua/78573, @mon1tor_ua/78576, @kpszsu/97584, @kpszsu/97592, @kpszsu/97593, @kpszsu/97597).

A Geran-5 drone struck the Burshtyn thermal power plant in Ivano-Frankivsk region, causing a direct hit on energy infrastructure; another Geran-5 fell on Privokzalna Street in Lviv, while one ran out of fuel and crashed in a forest near Shchyrets, Pustomyty, Komarno, and Velykyi Liubin (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78540, @mon1tor_ua/78567, @mon1tor_ua/78568).

Russia's 2027 federal budget allocates 17.1 trillion rubles for national defense (32% increase) and 4.6 trillion for national security, totaling 35% of planned expenditures; health spending is cut 3% to 1.81 trillion, social policy cut 6% to 6.65 trillion, with new taxes on gold miners and non-ferrous metals expected to raise 1.5 trillion rubles (Source: @DeepStateUA/24016).

Putin claimed the 'Kyiv regime' started the war in southeastern Ukraine, accused Kyiv of avoiding elections, and vowed 'much more painful' responses to Crimean Bridge attacks, asserting the bridge is exclusively civilian and that partial ceasefire discussions with the Security Council are now off the table (Source: @UkraineNow/85404, @UkraineNow/85405).

Trump reported Putin was 'furious' over the Crimean Bridge strike and described their meeting in China as lasting less than an hour; Trump also stated ~25,000 mostly soldiers die monthly and that a trilateral US-China-Russia meeting is planned (Source: @UkraineNow/85409, @UkraineNow/85390, @UkraineNow/85389).

Russian reconnaissance UAVs (РБпЛА) were observed over Chernihiv region near Slavutych and from Bryansk region, as well as over Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Cherkasy, and other regions, often equipped with MESH networking systems at 1 km altitude (Source: @eRadarrua/132054, @eRadarrua/132096, @eRadarrua/132090, @kpszsu/97585, @kpszsu/97571).

Dnipropetrovsk region faced five groups of strike UAVs, Kharkiv region two reactive UAV groups, and Mykolaiv region one reactive UAV group, indicating continued pressure on eastern and southern approaches (Source: @eRadarrua/132064).

Dnipropetrovsk region detected five groups of strike UAVs, suggesting sustained Russian aerial reconnaissance and attack operations targeting rear logistics and infrastructure in the eastern operational zone (Source: @eRadarrua/132064).
Kharkiv region tracked two groups of reactive UAVs, likely conducting surveillance or probing air defenses along the northeastern front line (Source: @eRadarrua/132064).

Mykolaiv region reported one reactive UAV group, while monitoring channels noted 3-4 Shahed drones from the Black Sea heading toward the Mykolaiv-Odesa border area, indicating a southern vector of attack (Source: @eRadarrua/132064, @mon1tor_ua/78576).

The Kerch Bridge railway strike by Ukrainian Neptune missiles directly impacts Russian eastern front logistics by severing the rail link that transports ammunition and fuel to the southern grouping; alternative land routes along the front line are exposed to Ukrainian drone interdiction (Source: @UkraineNow/85396).

Russian budget prioritization of 17.1 trillion rubles for defense in 2027 signals intent to sustain high-intensity operations on the eastern front for years, with increased procurement of drones, missiles, and artillery systems (Source: @DeepStateUA/24016).

Chernihiv region observed four regular UAVs entering from Bryansk region (Russia) and two reconnaissance UAVs near Slavutych, indicating persistent cross-border aerial activity from the north (Source: @eRadarrua/132096, @eRadarrua/132054).

Kyiv region tracked one reactive UAV group and multiple Shahed drones maneuvering over the capital throughout the day, with impacts in three districts and a ballistic missile strike near key bridges (Source: @eRadarrua/132062, @UkraineNow/85406, @mon1tor_ua/78559, @mon1tor_ua/78538).

Zhytomyr region recorded reactive UAVs near Kyivka, Irshansk, Emelchyne, and south of Korosten, mostly on westward courses toward Rivne and Lviv regions, suggesting transit corridors for drones launched from Belarus or northern Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/132052, @eRadarrua/132108, @kpszsu/97571, @kpszsu/97593).

Cherkasy region detected reactive UAVs near Smila and Tsvitkove, with one Geran-5 launched from Cherkasy toward Vinnytsia and another from Poltava heading to Cherkasy, indicating a north-south drone routing pattern (Source: @eRadarrua/132062, @eRadarrua/132108, @kpszsu/97597, @mon1tor_ua/78576).

Poltava region hosted a reactive UAV past Semenivka and served as a launch point for a Geran-5 toward Cherkasy, showing its use as a staging area for deep strikes (Source: @eRadarrua/132052, @mon1tor_ua/78576).

Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck the Kerch Bridge railway arch and tracks, halting train traffic; this bridge is described as a 'conveyor of war' for Russian southern grouping logistics, moving tankers and ammunition wagons (Source: @UkraineNow/85396).

Monitoring channels detected 3-4 reactive Shahed drones from the Black Sea heading toward the Mykolaiv-Odesa administrative border, demonstrating continued Russian use of maritime launch vectors for deep strikes (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78576).

Mykolaiv region tracked one reactive UAV group, while Kirovohrad region had one reactive UAV group and a Geran-5 headed toward Oleksandriia district, indicating a southern axis of drone operations (Source: @eRadarrua/132064, @mon1tor_ua/78576).

The UK-Norway funding of two strike boats for the Ukrainian Navy aims to strengthen Black Sea coastal defense and protect the maritime corridor that has transported 200 million tons of cargo, over half grain, since its opening (Source: @DeepStateUA/24014).

Putin's claim that the Crimean Bridge is exclusively civilian and transports no military cargo contradicts Ukrainian intelligence and the bridge's observed role in sustaining Russian forces in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia directions (Source: @UkraineNow/85405).
